name: Terramechanics: soil, wheel performance, wheel design, re-verification
description: Soil parameters from the database or identified from plate and shear tests (inverse workflow), single-wheel sinkage, drawbar pull and torque against slip (Wong-Reece), the wheel radius, width and grouser height for a drawbar pull within slip and sinkage limits at minimum mass, re-verified with the full model, and the model checked against the published single-wheel tests of Ding et al. (2011) (pinneapple_simulation.terramechanics.workflow).

params.title: Terramechanics: soil, wheel performance, wheel design, re-verification
